data.name: Nav.Decisions.Keywords
data.value: decisions to make anticipate suggestions to do priorities urgent next actions reminders deadlines autonomy dial

data.name: Decisions.Subtitle
data.value: What Lettra spotted in this file and suggests you decide, most urgent first. Fixed, verifiable rules: no AI decides.

data.name: Decisions.Dial.Hint
data.value: How far Lettra goes on its own. Whatever the setting, nothing goes out without your click, and every action runs with your rights.

data.name: Decisions.Dial.ReadOnly
data.value: Only a firm manager sets the dial for this file.

data.name: Decisions.Level.Show.Hint
data.value: Lettra flags the decision; you handle it from the related screen.

data.name: Decisions.Level.Prepare.Hint
data.value: Lettra prepares the action (the reminder to send…): one click on the button does it. Recommended.

data.name: Decisions.Empty.Text
data.value: Lettra watches payment reminders, tax deadlines, regulatory thresholds, supplier IBANs and vigilance certificates, and the anti-money-laundering file. A decision shows up here as soon as something needs doing.

data.name: Decisions.Dismissed
data.value: Decision dismissed: it won't be suggested again.

data.name: Decisions.Restored
data.value: Decision put back in the list.

data.name: Decisions.Changed
data.value: This decision changed in the meantime: the list is up to date, please read it again.

data.name: Decisions.Rules.Intro
data.value: Each decision comes from a written, tested rule, not from an AI. It settles by itself as soon as the situation is dealt with.

data.name: Decision.relance.due.Reason
data.value: {level}: the invoice is {days} days overdue and the reminder plan sends it today.

data.name: Decision.relance.due.Rule
data.value: Reminders due: an overdue invoice reaches a step of the reminder plan (nothing is suggested when automatic sending is on).

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.rappel.Title
data.value: Remind {client} that invoice {numero} is coming due

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.rappel.Reason
data.value: The invoice is due on {echeance}. A friendly reminder is planned today for this customer, whom the payment weather targets (they may object).

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.rappel.Rule
data.value: Reminders before the due date: a customer targeted by the payment weather should get their friendly reminder today (nothing is suggested when automatic sending is on).

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.echeance-manquee.Reason
data.value: Instalment {rang} of the payment plan is unpaid. The missed-instalment reminder is due today; the invoice is reminded only once per missed instalment.

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.echeance-manquee.Rule
data.value: Missed instalments: an instalment of a payment plan is unpaid and its reminder is due (nothing is suggested when automatic sending is on).

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.echeancier-a-voir.Title
data.value: Review the payment plan requested by {client} (invoice {numero})

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.echeancier-a-voir.Reason
data.value: {client} asked in their customer area to pay in {echeances} instalments, granted within the schedule's bounds. Mark it “Seen”, or stop it.

data.name: Decision.avant-le-retard.echeancier-a-voir.Rule
data.value: Payment plans to review: a customer requested a payment plan the business has not seen yet.

data.name: Decision.devis.a-relancer.Reason
data.value: Sent and still unanswered, it is no longer valid after {validUntil}. The suggested follow-up is written in the customer's language; to read or change it, open the quotes to follow up.

data.name: Decision.devis.a-relancer.Rule
data.value: Quotes to follow up: a sent, unanswered quote enters the follow-up window before it expires and has not been followed up yet.

data.name: Decision.fiscal.echeance.Reason
data.value: Period ended on {periodEnd}. Once filed, mark it filed in the tax calendar: the decision settles by itself.

data.name: Decision.fiscal.echeance.Rule
data.value: Tax deadlines: a return that is overdue or due within seven days and not yet marked filed.

data.name: Decision.seuil.proche.Reason
data.value: {change} So far: {toDateAmount} {basis} against a threshold of {thresholdAmount}; at this pace, {projectedAmount} by the end of the period.

data.name: Decision.seuil.proche.Rule
data.value: Thresholds: a regulatory threshold (VAT exemption or regime, quarterly VAT return, company category, vigilance certificate, DAS 2) is crossed, or will be within three months at the recent pace.

data.name: Decision.iban.a-verifier.Reason
data.value: Changed on {changedOn}. Confirm it through another channel than the request (the supplier's usual phone number) before any payment: that is the defence against supplier fraud.

data.name: Decision.iban.a-verifier.Rule
data.value: IBAN to check: a supplier's IBAN changed and has not been confirmed.

data.name: Decision.attestation.a-renouveler.Reason
data.value: Contract of {contractAmount} excl. VAT. Without a valid, checked URSSAF certificate, the file is jointly liable for the subcontractor's taxes and contributions in case of undeclared work.

data.name: Decision.attestation.a-renouveler.Rule
data.value: Vigilance certificates: a supplier at €5,000 excl. VAT or more whose certificate is missing, expired, unchecked or expiring within thirty days.

data.name: Decision.lcb-ft.fiche.Reason
data.value: The firm knows its client and reviews the file at the pace set by its risk level (anti-money-laundering duties).

data.name: Decision.lcb-ft.fiche.Rule
data.value: Anti-money laundering: the client file is missing, incomplete, due for review, or its review falls within thirty days (only for those who fill it in).

data.name: Error.Decision.NotFound
data.value: This decision no longer exists, or it is not meant for you.

data.name: Error.Decision.NotOpen
data.value: This decision has already been handled.

data.name: Error.Decision.NotRestorable
data.value: Only a dismissed or snoozed decision can be put back in the list.

data.name: Error.Decision.SnoozeDateInvalid
data.value: Pick a day between tomorrow and one year from now.

data.name: Error.Decision.NoAction
data.value: Nothing to do in one click here: open the details to handle this decision.

data.name: Error.Decision.ActionUnavailable
data.value: This action is no longer available on this installation: open the details to handle the decision.

data.name: Error.Decision.LevelInvalid
data.value: This dial setting does not exist.
